purpose: Persistent evidence record for WordPress Playground validation. Passing automated smoke checks does not equal full product verification.

environment.environmentSelection: Playground-selected current versions during the recorded Content Check run

verificationPolicy: Do not mark a product verified until installation, activation, product-specific runtime checks, manual editor/front-end behavior, and relevant compatibility checks have been recorded.

recordedRun.notes: A first attempt using do_action('add_meta_boxes', 'post') caused a WordPress critical-error response. The smoke test was changed to inspect the registered hook without invoking the full metabox lifecycle. A fresh run then passed the installation, activation, class-loading, and hook-registration checks.

manualChecks: Open a disposable post in the editor
Confirm warnings are relevant and advisory

products.fix: Version 1.0.1 rewrites the editor renderer to avoid a PHP string-quoting parse error and render labels via DOM text nodes. A rebuilt ZIP has been published; rerun installation and activation against that package.
manualChecks: Create a test post with images
Check missing, empty, and present alt labels
Test readable links, empty labels, placeholder destinations, javascript: links, and target=_blank without rel=noopener
Check custom wpm, label, and suffix attributes

notClaimed: Compatibility across all PHP and WordPress versions
